messages.subject: Re-review B1 remains through MCP
messages.body: Exact commit 33b97fc: legacy HTTP accept vs Commons reject serialized in 12 fresh JSON trials, but real SDK MCP clients calling review_curation_proposal through /mcp can both succeed on contradictory reviews and persist RelationAccepted plus RelationRejected. MCP register-tools.ts:343-345 still calls the outer curation service directly; B1 disposition is PARTIAL and G4 remains blocked. Reproduction artifacts are under /home/nuc/projects/op-commons-review-3/; final report forthcoming.
